_why: Serve the production build. Build: `npm ci && VITE_READING_ENABLED=1 npm run build` (the only public build flag; production has it on since 2026-10-22, and the built bundle hash matched production's on 2026-10-23). The bundle carries the live Stripe publishable key and the live $19 Payment Link, so everything off-origin stays blocked: no allowHosts. Mocks: /api/verify-purchase answers {verified:true, sessionId:'cs_test_persona'} for GET (the #session_id redirect) and POST (email restore), so an unlock completes on screen without touching Stripe. /api/reading answers from api/_readings/index.json, picking the entry by the `key` query parameter (the harness's bodyFile/select mock, added 2026-10-23), so the paid Reading a persona opens is the real text for their own pairing; an unknown key gets the route's own 404 body. paidState mirrors what useAuth leaves behind after a verified purchase: lp_pro, lp_stripe_session_id (the Reading route reads it as the x-reading-session header), and the one-time lp_just_purchased banner flag. Ports 5188/7311 are the defaults; agents pass APP_PORT/CTRL_PORT for their own pair. The repo has no Playwright: run the harness with NODE_PATH=<our-family-lizard>/node_modules (see brief.md).
